answer: An agent market for shale deliveries, wharf access, and meadow leases can weight governance votes by tokens locked in escrow for 90 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 1,000 locked tokens among a thousand fake agents gives the attacker exactly the same voting power as one agent holding all 1,000. To gain more influence, the attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital that cannot be spent or sold during the lock period.
